races.name: Classic Car Show On 9th June Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Bontessony Doll
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but completely unknown quantity with limited experience and 149 days since last run creates major question marks

runners_data.name: Medina Blue
runners_data.note: Lightly raced hold-up type with decent recent form but 220 days absence is a significant concern despite trainer running well

runners_data.name: Gone Away Madam
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who won over course and distance on similar going but 760-day absence is a major worry

runners_data.name: Arctic Voyage
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse with strong recent form and RPR 118 suggests he's well-handicapped off OR 112

runners_data.name: Jubertilee
runners_data.note: Patient hold-up type who stays well but OR 89 looks vulnerable in this grade despite recent second

runners_data.name: Keep Off The Sugar
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with concerning finishing fade tendency and 57 days off after disappointing efforts

runners_data.name: Lirone Du Seuil
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner from top stable but 107-day break and mixed recent form over shorter trips raises questions

runners_data.name: Arbitration
runners_data.note: Front runner from powerful stable but 217 days absent and unproven over this longer distance creates doubt

runners_data.name: Blue Siam
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse getting significant weight allowance but modest OR 89 and poor recent form suggests limited ability

runners_data.name: Louis Des Landes
runners_data.note: Patient type from good stable with just 19 days since last run but poor recent form suggests he's regressing

races.paceDynamic: Gone Away Madam and Arbitration will set a genuine gallop from the start, with both confirmed front runners likely to contest the early lead. Gone Away Madam showed she can sustain a bold front-running effort when winning over course and distance on good going, while Arbitration brings similar pace pressures having led in recent outings. This honest tempo will stretch the field and create a true test of stamina over the 2m1f trip. The sustained gallop heavily favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as the early pace will take its toll on prominent runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Gone Away Madam and Arbitration both go forward and sustain a genuine pace throughout
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will stretch the field and find out the stamina of prominent runners, allowing hold-up horses to close strongly in the final furlong. Arctic Voyage and the other patient types can time their challenges perfectly as the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates Soft Pace
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets an easy lead with the other failing to go forward early
scenarios.body: Gone Away Madam or Arbitration can dictate terms at a comfortable tempo and kick clear when the pace lifts, making them hard to peg back. The hold-up horses will have too much ground to make up in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners tie up dramatically after setting unsustainable fractions early on
scenarios.body: The pace will be suicidal early before completely falling apart, allowing a patient hold-up horse to pick up the pieces from the back. This benefits the most conservative riders who stay well off the early pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters set reasonable fractions but one prominent runner can track and outkick them
scenarios.body: A horse like Medina Blue can sit just behind the leaders and have enough left to collar them in the final 100 yards. This requires perfect positioning and the front runners not getting too soft a lead.

watchPoints.text: Gone Away Madam's 760-day absence is extreme even for a course winner - watch for any signs of rustiness or fitness concerns in preliminaries
Arctic Voyage carries 157lbs as topweight but recent form suggests he's well-handicapped - market support would be significant
Both Arbitration and Gone Away Madam need to go forward early - if either misses the break it completely changes the pace scenario
Keep Off The Sugar has shown a tendency to fade in the finish - watch for any early signs of struggling before the final furlong
Lirone Du Seuil represents the Dan Skelton stable who excel with returning horses - any market confidence would be notable

races.name: Day Before Terry Wheeler's Birthday Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Evening Tess
runners_data.note: Sole pace-setter gets tactical advantage with sustainable gallop, Harry Skelton's 33% strike-rate with Dan Skelton and 11-day break ideal

runners_data.name: Isabella Islay
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces traffic concerns but highest RPR of 99 and class edge, 49-day absence could blunt sharpness

runners_data.name: Georgia's Charm
runners_data.note: Apprentice Fern O'Brien takes valuable 5lb off but hold-up style problematic, solid record on similar going

runners_data.name: Blackwater Lilly
runners_data.note: Top-rated on 100 but heaviest weight at 168lbs and hold-up style creates positioning problems, Neil King yard in form

runners_data.name: Yanka Blue
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer but Barry Murphy's 0/11 record and need for splits against her, 9-day turnaround quick

runners_data.name: Reel Orange
runners_data.note: Joe Tizzard hold-up mare with good recent form but traffic concerns prominent, quick 7-day turnaround

runners_data.name: Miss Pearl
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up runner giving weight all round after 385-day break, hard to fancy despite lightest burden

runners_data.name: Kylenoe Dancer
runners_data.note: Only prominent runner to track Evening Tess, Tom Bellamy's tactical awareness crucial, joint-trainers strike when ready

races.paceDynamic: Evening Tess will lead unchallenged with only Kylenoe Dancer likely to race prominently, creating a sustainable galloping pace without early pressure. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Isabella Islay, Blackwater Lilly, Reel Orange, Yanka Blue, Georgia's Charm and Miss Pearl will settle behind the modest early pace. This tactical setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable late traffic problems, while hold-up horses face a significant disadvantage trying to weave through the field in the closing stages. The lack of pace pressure clearly benefits those racing on or close to the speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Evening Tess maintains her recent improved form and gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows her to dictate terms throughout and kick clear when the field comes under pressure. Harry Skelton can time her effort perfectly without having to fight for position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large pack of hold-up horses get shuffled back and struggle for racing room
scenarios.body: The congested finish plays into the hands of those who positioned themselves handy and avoided the scramble. Isabella Islay's class tells if she gets a clear passage but many others will find trouble.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Position Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If Kylenoe Dancer tracks Evening Tess closely and stays out of trouble
scenarios.body: The Kim Bailey runner can pounce when the leader weakens and stay clear of the late charge from the pack. Tom Bellamy's positioning proves crucial in a race where tactics matter more than raw ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get perfect splits and the early pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: Reel Orange and Blackwater Lilly find the gaps needed to unleash their finishing kicks. This requires almost perfect race-riding and luck with positioning that rarely aligns for multiple horses.

watchPoints.text: Evening Tess stumbles early hurdles - removes only pace angle and creates tactical chaos
Isabella Islay gets shuffled back early - highest-rated needs handy position to utilize class advantage
Multiple hold-up horses converge on inner rail approaching final turn - creates traffic jam
Kylenoe Dancer tracks too close to Evening Tess - risks getting carried along at unsustainable pace
Blackwater Lilly carries 168lbs over extended trip - weight burden tells in testing ground conditions

races.name: Racing Welfare Supporting Mental Health Awareness Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Anyharminasking
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces a major tactical disadvantage with limited pace to aim at in this small field, despite highest class rating.

runners_data.name: Move With The Beat
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with excellent recent form including two wins, well-suited to tracking the leader and having first run on this galloping track.

runners_data.name: Siam Park
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner who will get an uncontested lead but recent form shows inconsistency with falls and poor runs mixed with good efforts.

runners_data.name: Inca De Lafayette
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the race shape and carries top weight off a good recent win, though 38 days since last run may need the outing.

races.paceDynamic: Siam Park will take the field along from the front with no pressure from the limited field, setting a sustainable gallop over this extended 2m5f trip. Move With The Beat and Inca De Lafayette are both prominent racers who will track the leader closely, while Anyharminasking sits at the back as the lone hold-up horse. With only four runners and one confirmed front-runner, the pace will be moderate throughout allowing the leaders to maintain their positions. This race shape strongly favours the prominent racers and leader who can control the tempo and have first run on the turn for home, while the hold-up horse faces a difficult task with limited pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Control Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Siam Park maintains a steady gallop and the prominent racers stay handy
scenarios.body: The controlled pace suits those up with the pace who can quicken when it matters rather than relying on a strong finish. Move With The Beat and Inca De Lafayette benefit from tracking the leader closely and having first run.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Siam Park gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: With no pressure on the leader and a sustainable pace, Siam Park can dictate terms and prove hard to peg back up the hill. The prominent racers may react too late to his move.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Move With The Beat and Inca De Lafayette both challenge Siam Park early in the straight
scenarios.body: The two prominent racers engage in a battle that suits their forward-going styles over this staying trip. Their superior recent form and class ratings give them the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Sweep
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and Anyharminasking gets a strong run through
scenarios.body: Despite limited pace to aim at, if the leaders stop quickly enough Anyharminasking's class could tell. This scenario requires the front three to go too fast early or hit the wall late.

watchPoints.text: Anyharminasking needs the leaders to go too fast early or collapse late, but with only Siam Park setting the pace this is unlikely
Siam Park's recent form includes two falls and could find the extended trip stretching his stamina despite getting an easy lead
Move With The Beat has won twice recently in similar conditions and Isabelle Ryder's 5lb claim reduces the weight burden significantly
Inca De Lafayette carries top weight of 162lbs and is having first run for 38 days which may blunt his finishing kick
The small field of four means less cover for Anyharminasking and fewer pace angles to exploit from his hold-up position

races.name: Come Racing On 27th May Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Blacksamssenorita
runners_data.note: Natural front runner likely to lead but faces pressure from multiple prominent types, returning after 36-day break could blunt finishing kick

runners_data.name: Cobbler's Boy
runners_data.note: Only confirmed hold-up horse with recent winning form and strong trainer statistics, perfectly positioned if pace scenario develops as expected

runners_data.name: Ellerton
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 167-day layoff for Tizzard team struggling for winners, distance and ground suit but fitness question marks

runners_data.name: One Island
runners_data.note: Young improver for top connections but lacks tactical variety being another prominent runner in a pace-heavy field

runners_data.name: Stinginhisstep
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer but faces pace pressure from better-rated rivals, lowest official rating creates handicap challenge

races.paceDynamic: Blacksamssenorita will likely lead or sit prominently early, but with four other horses all showing prominent tendencies (Ellerton, One Island, Stinginhisstep) plus Cobbler's Boy as the lone hold-up specialist, this shapes as a competitive pace scenario. The multiple prominent runners will create genuine tempo pressure through the early stages, preventing Blacksamssenorita from getting an easy lead. With sustained pressure likely from the flag and only one confirmed closer in Cobbler's Boy, this race setup strongly favours the hold-up running style profile, as the pace will be honest enough to set up a strong finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners (Blacksamssenorita, Ellerton, One Island, Stinginhisstep) engage early and maintain honest tempo
scenarios.body: The pace becomes testing through the middle stages, leaving the front group vulnerable to a strong closer. Cobbler's Boy's hold-up style becomes the winning profile as he picks up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Blacksamssenorita Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Blacksamssenorita gets an easy lead with the other prominent runners settling behind without pressure
scenarios.body: She dictates comfortable fractions and has enough in reserve to resist late challenges. Her proven front-running ability on similar ground becomes decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too fast early and come back dramatically in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and recent form matter most. Fresh legs and tactical positioning become crucial over running style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys overcomplicate tactics with multiple runners trying to avoid making the running
scenarios.body: A stop-start affair develops where the best horse on the day wins regardless of style. Pure ability trumps tactical advantage.

watchPoints.text: Cobbler's Boy if he gets too far back early - Skelton needs to position closer than usual given the likely pace scenario
Blacksamssenorita's jumping under pressure - any mistake when others challenge could be costly given the competitive field
Ellerton's fitness after 167-day absence - watch for any signs of rustiness in the early exchanges
One Island and Stinginhisstep engaging too early - both need to conserve energy for the finish rather than getting involved in pace battles
The pace through the middle section - if it becomes stop-start rather than sustained, the tactical picture changes completely

races.name: St. Austell Brewery Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Certainly Red
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 67-day break but has strong recent form including a win, benefits from patient tactics this race shape will provide

runners_data.name: Viroflay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who will dictate pace with Miss Nicholls' 5lb claim useful, though three hold-up horses behind may prove hard to resist

runners_data.name: Hoe Joly Smoke
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with hat-trick chance carrying least weight at 156lbs, Skelton's 33% strike rate with trainer Dan Skelton adds confidence

runners_data.name: Lord Baddesley
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent form has declined sharply, needs the tactical race this setup provides but form trend is concerning

races.paceDynamic: Viroflay will take the field along from the front with his prominent style, setting a sustainable gallop that won't stress him early. With only four runners and three hold-up horses behind him (Certainly Red, Hoe Joly Smoke, Lord Baddesley), there's minimal pace pressure allowing Viroflay to dictate terms throughout the 3m2f trip. The lack of early pace will create a tactical affair where stamina and finishing kick become paramount in the final stages. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce their best effort late, as they'll get the steady early fractions needed to unleash their finishing speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Viroflay sets pedestrian fractions with no early pressure from the three hold-up types
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the best stayers with tactical speed prevail, as they get perfect conditions to wind up their finishing kicks. Certainly Red and Hoe Joly Smoke benefit most from the patient ride and strong finish this setup demands.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Viroflay Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Viroflay's sustainable pace proves too much for the hold-up horses to peg back
scenarios.body: His prominent running style allows him to build an insurmountable lead as the three hold-up horses leave themselves too much to do. The Paul Nicholls-trained gelding has the stamina reserves to resist late challenges having dictated the tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Skelton Tactical Masterclass
scenarios.trigger: If Harry Skelton positions Hoe Joly Smoke closer to the pace than his usual hold-up style
scenarios.body: This allows Hoe Joly Smoke to track Viroflay more prominently and strike earlier than the other hold-up horses expect. The 12lb weight advantage over Viroflay becomes decisive when combined with superior positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Eliminates Field
scenarios.trigger: If the 3m2f trip on good ground becomes a genuine staying test that finds out the weaker stayers
scenarios.body: Lord Baddesley's recent form collapse continues as the distance exposes his limitations, while others also struggle with the demands. Only the most genuine stayers survive to contest the finish.

watchPoints.text: Viroflay building an unassailable lead if the three hold-up horses are content to sit too far back early
Certainly Red's fitness levels after 67 days off, though his hold-up style suits this race shape perfectly
Harry Skelton's positioning of Hoe Joly Smoke - whether he sticks to hold-up tactics or tracks Viroflay more closely
Lord Baddesley's recent form slump continuing as his confidence appears shot based on last three runs
The pace through the middle sections - if Viroflay goes too steady it sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses' finishing kicks

races.name: Totnes And Bridgetown Chase Company Open Hunters' Chase

runners_data.name: Regatta De Blanc
runners_data.note: Prominent racer carrying just 161lbs with good recent hunter chase form, though 54 days since last run raises slight fitness questions.

runners_data.name: Golden Son
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with highest rating (OR 130) and Paul Nicholls' 3/9 recent strike-rate, wearing tongue-tie suggests respiratory management.

runners_data.name: Get Off Your Phone
runners_data.note: Lightly raced 7-year-old with unknown stamina credentials over this extended trip, making him a tactical wildcard.

runners_data.name: High Game Royal
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer with solid recent form and just 12 days since last run ensuring peak fitness.

runners_data.name: Fongs Way
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent racer returning after 1092 days off, making fitness a major concern despite tongue-tie equipment.

runners_data.name: Est Illic
runners_data.note: Experienced 12-year-old prominent racer with solid recent hunter chase form and good going record on similar surfaces.

races.paceDynamic: Golden Son is the likely pace-setter with proven front-running ability and Paul Nicholls' tactical approach, while several prominent racers including Regatta De Blanc and High Game Royal will track close behind. The small field of six means no genuine pace pressure, allowing Golden Son to dictate terms and kick for home when ready. This sustainable tempo over 3m2f will test stamina reserves in the final half-mile, with the lack of early pace likely creating a sprint finish between those who can quicken off steady gallop. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace and respond to Golden Son's move.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Golden Son Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Son gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions without pressure.
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls runner can measure out his effort perfectly over this stamina test and kick clear when others struggle to respond. His class advantage (OR 130) becomes decisive when he can race on his own terms.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Golden Son for the early lead creating genuine pace.
scenarios.body: The increased gallop finds out the stamina limitations of some runners and sets up a tactical finish between the strongest stayers. Regatta De Blanc's recent form and racing weight advantage could prove crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Tactical Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a crawling tactical affair.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the last fence where younger legs and recent race fitness matter most. Get Off Your Phone's unknown stamina reserves over this trip could be exposed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders underperform due to race fitness or jumping errors.
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows an outsider to stay in contention and capitalize on mistakes from the more fancied runners. Est Illic's experience at this game could prove valuable.

watchPoints.text: Golden Son's jumping under pressure - any mistakes could hand initiative to Regatta De Blanc tracking behind
Get Off Your Phone's stamina reserves over this extended trip remain completely untested in hunter chases
Fongs Way's fitness levels after 1092 days absence despite recent point-to-point runs
High Game Royal's ability to quicken off the likely steady pace given his consistent but moderate rating
Regatta De Blanc's race sharpness after 54-day layoff when pace quickens approaching final fences
